faqs.q: What is Sovely Dropshipping and how does it work?
faqs.a: Sovely Dropshipping is an ecommerce dropshipping platform that helps entrepreneurs start and grow an online business without buying or maintaining inventory. You choose products from the catalogue, list them on your store or selling channel, and receive customer orders. Sovely supports fulfilment (packing, dispatch and delivery coordination) so you can focus on marketing and customers.

faqs.q: Who is Sovely Dropshipping for?
faqs.a: Beginners, aspiring entrepreneurs, small sellers and established ecommerce businesses. You do not need to buy in bulk, run a warehouse, or manage your own packing and shipping. You can start with a small product selection, test demand, and expand gradually.

faqs.q: Do I need technical knowledge or ecommerce experience?
faqs.a: No. Sovely simplifies product selection and fulfilment so you can concentrate on marketing. Higher plans also include hands-on training: product listing training (Shopify), and Ads, SEO and AI-prompt training (Amazon).

faqs.q: Do I need to buy or store inventory?
faqs.a: No. There is zero inventory risk: list products first and order from Sovely only after your customer places and pays for an order. There is no upfront stock, storage or wastage.

faqs.q: How many products and categories can I access?
faqs.a: The plan documents list access to 10,000+ unique products across 25+ categories, all ready to list with no sourcing delays.

faqs.q: Which product categories are available?
faqs.a: Examples include Health and Beauty, Fashion and Accessories, Home and Kitchen, Electronics and Gadgets, Car Accessories, Fitness and Workout, Toys and Games, Travel Accessories, Home Decor, and Daily Use Products.

faqs.q: Why choose Sovely Dropshipping over traditional ecommerce?
faqs.a:
Traditional ecommerce needs money tied up in stock, storage, packaging and shipping. With Sovely Dropshipping you can:
• Start without bulk inventory
• Access a ready-to-sell catalogue across many categories
• Sell through your own store or marketplace account
• Offer Cash on Delivery (COD) where supported
• Use Pan India delivery at a flat {charges.delivery} per order
• Have tracking, COD and RTO handled for you

faqs.q: Can I sell across India?
faqs.a: Yes. Sovely supports Pan India delivery through its courier network, subject to courier serviceability and product availability for the customer's pincode.

faqs.q: Where can I sell Sovely products?
faqs.a: On your own Shopify store, on Amazon (Marketplace, Amazon Bazar and B2B on the Amazon plans), and by promoting through Instagram, Facebook and WhatsApp to attract customers and enquiries.

faqs.q: Will products be shipped to my customers without Sovely branding?
faqs.a: Yes. Sovely supports direct-to-customer fulfilment and aims to give a white-label experience so you can build your own brand.

faqs.q: How does Sovely help me increase sales?
faqs.a: By giving you a wide ready-to-sell range, fulfilment support, Pan India delivery, and (on higher plans) store setup, listings, ads and training, so your time goes into promotion and customer acquisition.

faqs.q: Can I scale my business with Sovely Dropshipping?
faqs.a: Yes. Start with a few products, find what sells, and widen your catalogue as you grow. The Basic Plan is the foundation of every higher plan, and you can upgrade to Amazon or Shopify anytime.

faqs.q: Is there a registration fee or monthly subscription?
faqs.a: Sovely Dropshipping charges a one-time platform access fee, with no monthly platform subscription. Product costs, shipping fees, COD charges and other service charges still apply to the orders and services you use.

faqs.q: What does the Basic Plan include?

faqs.q: What does the Shopify Plan include?
faqs.a: The {shopify.name} is {shopify.price} (regular {shopify.regularPrice}), a one-time fee. It includes {shopify.features}.

faqs.q: What does the Amazon Plan include?
faqs.a: The {amazon.name} is {amazon.price} (regular {amazon.regularPrice}), a one-time fee, or {amazon.gstPrice} if you're already GST registered. It includes {amazon.features}.

faqs.q: Is there a discount if I already have GST?

faqs.q: What is the Amazon + Shopify Combo?

faqs.q: Can I sell on Amazon Marketplace, Amazon Bazar and B2B at the same time?
faqs.a: Yes. The Amazon Plan lets you sell on Amazon Marketplace, Amazon Bazar and Amazon B2B simultaneously.

faqs.q: Does the Shopify Plan include Facebook and Instagram ads?
faqs.a: Yes, it includes creating and managing live Facebook ad campaigns, plus page creation and Shopify and Facebook integration. This FAQ does not say whether the ad budget itself is covered, so confirm this with the Sovely Dropshipping team before you sign up.

faqs.q: What do all plans include for logistics?
faqs.a: A flat {charges.delivery} delivery charge per order Pan India; {facts.couriers} courier partners ({facts.courierNames}); a same-day tracking ID for every order; fully managed COD and RTO; and a minimum margin of {facts.minMargin}.

faqs.q: What does the "100%+ minimum margin" mean?
faqs.a: Sovely Dropshipping's B2B pricing is designed so that your profit margin stays at 100% or more on every sale. Your actual profit still depends on the selling price you set and the applicable costs.

faqs.q: What support do I get?
faqs.a: Basic: a dedicated support team from day one. Shopify and Combo: a dedicated account manager (one manager across both platforms for the Combo). Amazon: lifetime support and a dedicated account manager.

faqs.q: Can I upgrade later?
faqs.a: Yes. The Basic Plan is the core of every higher plan, and you can upgrade to the Amazon or Shopify plan anytime.

It depends on where you want to sell:
• {basic.name} ({basic.price}): if you already run an online business and want products plus operations.
• {shopify.name} ({shopify.price}): for your own branded store with ads and social pages.
• {amazon.name} ({amazon.price}, or {amazon.gstPrice} with GST): for GST, account launch and listings on Amazon.
• {combo.name} ({combo.price}): if you want both, at the lowest total price.
You can also message us on WhatsApp at {contact.whatsapp} for advice.

faqs.q: How do I get started?
faqs.a: Choose the plan that fits you, get access to the Sovely Dropshipping panel, pick products from the catalogue, and list them on your store or selling channel. When a customer orders and pays, you place the order with Sovely Dropshipping through the panel and fulfilment begins.

faqs.q: How quickly can my store go live?
faqs.a: On the Shopify Plan, Sovely Dropshipping aims to have you live with a fully loaded store, active social pages and running ads in a matter of days.

faqs.q: Does Sovely Dropshipping set up my Shopify store?
faqs.a: Yes. The Shopify Plan launches your Shopify account and builds the store from scratch, lists 4,000+ products, and trains you in product listing so you can keep growing it yourself.

faqs.q: Does Sovely Dropshipping register GST for me?
faqs.a: Yes, on the Amazon Plan and the Combo: GST registration and legal compliance management are included, along with Amazon account launching, category approval and GTIN exception. If you are already GST registered, you receive {amazon.gstDiscount} off the {amazon.name}.

faqs.q: Do you help with Amazon account health?
faqs.a: Yes. The Amazon Plan includes account health check tracking, Ad training, SEO training and AI-based prompt training to launch products.

faqs.q: Is KYC required, and what documents do I need?
faqs.a: Sovely Dropshipping has a dedicated KYC Policy. This FAQ does not list the specific documents or steps, so check the KYC Policy page after logging in, or ask the support team before you pay.

faqs.q: Is training included?
faqs.a: Yes, on the plans that need it: product listing training (Shopify), and Ad, SEO and AI-prompt training (Amazon). The Combo includes both.

faqs.q: Can I choose my own selling price?
faqs.a: Yes. Set it based on your strategy, audience, competition and target margin. Your earnings are the difference between your selling price and all applicable product and fulfilment costs.

faqs.q: Can I see my profit before placing an order?
faqs.a: Yes. Before confirming an order you can estimate profit from your customer's selling price and the applicable product, shipping (flat {charges.delivery} per order), COD and other charges.

faqs.q: How does Sovely Dropshipping help me earn better margins?
faqs.a: Sovely Dropshipping offers competitive B2B product pricing designed to keep your minimum margin at 100%+ on every sale, without bulk inventory purchases. With no stock or warehouse to manage, more of your money goes into marketing and growth.

faqs.q: How many products can I list?
faqs.a: On the Basic Plan you can access all 10,000+ products. The Shopify Plan lists 4,000+ products on your store for you, and the Amazon Plan provides 500+ SEO-optimised listings. You can keep adding more after launch.

faqs.q: Who checks product quality?
faqs.a: Sovely Dropshipping performs quality control before shipment. If a problem appears after shipment (defect or damage), follow the process with an unboxing video and supporting documents.

faqs.q: Where can I find product details and descriptions?
faqs.a: Product details, including whether an item is marked non-returnable, appear in the product description. Sovely Dropshipping also has a Product Description Policy (available on the Sovely Dropshipping portal after login). This FAQ does not detail its rules, so read that page after logging in and match your own listings to it.

faqs.q: How do I place and track an order?
faqs.a: Place orders through the Sovely Dropshipping panel. Every order gets a same-day tracking ID, and your customers receive same-day tracking updates. You can follow processing, dispatch, delivery and return status from your order management and tracking view.

faqs.q: Can I cancel an order after it is confirmed?
faqs.a: No. Orders are processed immediately to ensure prompt delivery, so cancellations are not permitted after confirmation. In rare cases Sovely Dropshipping may cancel an order itself (item out of stock, a pricing error, or an unserviceable pincode), and then the full amount is refunded.

faqs.q: Can I change an order after confirmation (address, products or other details)?
faqs.a: No. After confirmation, no changes such as adding products, changing the delivery address or updating the order are allowed.

faqs.q: What should I check before confirming an order?
faqs.a: The customer's full address and pincode, the product and quantity, and the amounts. Because nothing can be edited afterwards, accuracy at this step prevents failed deliveries and RTO costs.

faqs.q: Can Sovely Dropshipping cancel my order?
faqs.a: In rare cases, yes: if the item is out of stock, a pricing error occurs, or the delivery pincode is not serviceable.

faqs.q: Do I get my money back if Sovely Dropshipping cancels an order?
faqs.a: Yes. When Sovely Dropshipping cancels an order for one of these reasons, the full amount is refunded.

faqs.q: What if my customer asks me to cancel after I have confirmed the order?
faqs.a: The cancellation policy does not allow it. If the customer later refuses delivery, the RTO and rejection rules apply, including shipping deductions.

faqs.q: What is the delivery charge?
faqs.a: A flat {charges.delivery} per order, Pan India, on every plan.

faqs.q: Which courier partners do you use?
faqs.a: 20+ partners, including Bluedart, DTDC, Ekart and Amazon.

faqs.q: Who handles packing and dispatch?
faqs.a: Sovely Dropshipping supports fulfilment, including packing, dispatch and coordination with delivery partners, shipped directly to your customer.

faqs.q: How long does dispatch and delivery take?
faqs.a: Dispatch depends on product availability, order confirmation, warehouse processing and other operational factors. This FAQ does not give a fixed number of days for dispatch or delivery; delivery time depends on the courier and the customer's location.

faqs.q: Can I deliver to every pincode in India?
faqs.a: Sovely Dropshipping delivers Pan India, subject to courier serviceability and product availability at the customer's pincode. If a pincode is not serviceable, the order may be cancelled with a full refund.

faqs.q: What is RTO and who manages it?
faqs.a: RTO (Return to Origin) happens when an order cannot be delivered and goes back to the dispatch location. Sovely Dropshipping fully manages RTO and COD on every plan. RTO charges depend on shipment weight, courier partner, delivery location and the shipping policy.

faqs.q: What happens if my customer refuses the parcel or is unavailable?
faqs.a: The courier may start an NDR (Non-Delivery Report) or RTO process. Where supported, reattempts or address corrections may be coordinated, and charges may apply. If a customer rejects a parcel after dispatch, 2 times the original shipping charge (forward plus reverse shipping) is deducted before any refund is issued.

faqs.q: Can I reduce RTO?
faqs.a: Confirm the customer's address, pincode and phone number before you confirm the order, since orders cannot be edited afterwards, and make sure your customer expects the delivery, particularly for COD orders.

faqs.q: Where can I read the full shipping rules?
faqs.a: In Sovely Dropshipping's Shipping Policy (available on the Sovely Dropshipping portal after login).

faqs.q: Who handles customer returns and refunds?
faqs.a: As a dropshipping partner you handle your customers' enquiries, returns and refunds. Sovely Dropshipping assists in resolving product issues caused by manufacturing or shipping errors.

faqs.q: How long do I have to report a problem?
faqs.a: 48 hours from the time the product is received. Requests made after 48 hours may not be accepted.

faqs.q: What if the product arrives damaged or defective?
faqs.a: Notify Sovely Dropshipping within 48 hours and provide an unboxing video showing the damage. After the damage or defect is confirmed, Sovely Dropshipping will either replace the product at no additional charge or issue a full refund. For end-customer claims, a full or partial refund is processed based on approval.

faqs.q: Why is an unboxing video required?
faqs.a: It is the evidence used to assess damage, defects and missing items. The video must clearly show the package being opened and its contents. Claims without it are hard to verify.

faqs.q: What if items are missing from the order?
faqs.a: Notify Sovely Dropshipping within 48 hours of receipt with an unboxing video showing the package contents. If the claim is confirmed after investigation, the missing items are refunded when Sovely Dropshipping cannot fulfil them.

faqs.q: What if the wrong item was shipped?
faqs.a: If the error was Sovely Dropshipping's, the item is replaced or a full refund is offered.

faqs.q: Can I return or get a refund for electronic products?
faqs.a: No. Electronic products are non-returnable, and no return or refund can be processed for defective electronics.

faqs.q: Which items are not eligible for return or refund?
faqs.a:
• Products that have been used, opened or damaged by the customer
• Products marked as non-returnable in the product description
• Electronic products

faqs.q: In what condition must a returned product be?
faqs.a: Unused, undamaged and in its original condition with the original packaging. A refund is issued only if these conditions are met.

faqs.q: How do I raise a return or refund request?
faqs.a:
1. Notify Sovely Dropshipping within 48 hours of the order being received.
2. Submit the unboxing video and any supporting documents.
3. Wait for Sovely Dropshipping to approve or reject the request after assessment.
4. If approved, follow the return process and keep your customer informed. The customer ships the item back to Sovely Dropshipping.
5. After the item is received and inspected, Sovely Dropshipping issues the refund or replacement, whichever was communicated earlier during confirmation.

faqs.q: Who pays return shipping?
faqs.a: The customer or dropshipper bears the return shipping cost. Use a reliable, tracked shipping service to protect the return.

faqs.q: Are shipping charges refundable?
faqs.a: No. Shipping charges are non-refundable in all circumstances and for any reason, covering both the original shipping fee and any return shipping cost.

faqs.q: How long does a refund take?
faqs.a: Once the return is received and inspected, Sovely Dropshipping informs you whether the refund is approved or rejected. If approved, the refund goes to the original payment method within 7 days of approval.

faqs.q: What deductions apply if a customer rejects a parcel?
faqs.a: If a customer rejects or refuses a parcel after dispatch, 2 times the original shipping charge (forward and reverse shipping) is deducted before any refund is issued.

faqs.q: Where can I read the full return and refund terms?
faqs.a: In the Return & Refund Policy (available on the Sovely Dropshipping portal after login).

faqs.q: Does Sovely Dropshipping support Cash on Delivery (COD)?
faqs.a: Yes. Customers can pay when the order is delivered. COD availability depends on the courier service, delivery location and order eligibility.

faqs.q: Who collects COD payments from customers?
faqs.a: The authorised delivery partner collects COD at the time of delivery, and the amount goes through the applicable settlement process. You can track eligible order payments and settlements on your portal.

faqs.q: How is my profit calculated?
faqs.a: Your selling price minus the applicable product cost, shipping charges, COD fees, taxes and other charges.

faqs.q: How and when do I receive my profit?
faqs.a: After successful delivery and payment reconciliation, your eligible earnings are processed under Sovely Dropshipping's settlement and payout policy. The amount appears in your portal wallet, which you can redeem anytime.

faqs.q: Do I earn profit on RTO or rejected orders?
faqs.a: Earnings are processed after successful delivery and payment reconciliation, so an undelivered order does not generate profit. RTO charges and the shipping deductions may apply.

faqs.q: Are there withdrawal limits, timelines or fees?
faqs.a: Sovely Dropshipping has a Withdrawal Policy (available on the Sovely Dropshipping portal after login). This FAQ does not state minimum amounts, processing times or fees, so check that page after logging in or ask support.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund of my plan fee?
faqs.a: This FAQ does not state a refund rule for the one-time plan fee. Ask the Sovely Dropshipping team and get the answer in writing before paying.

faqs.q: Where can I see my payments and settlements?
faqs.a: In the Sovely Dropshipping portal, where you can see your wallet balance and the status of eligible order payments.

faqs.q: Which policies apply to me as a Sovely Dropshipping partner?
faqs.a: Sovely Dropshipping publishes these policies: Terms, Order Cancellation Policy, Privacy Policy, Grievance Redressal Policy, Return & Refund Policy, Withdrawal Policy, Shipping Policy, Product Description Policy and KYC Policy.

faqs.q: Where do I find the Terms of use?
faqs.a: On the Terms page in the Sovely Dropshipping portal (available after login). Read it before you buy a plan or place your first order.

faqs.q: How is my personal and business data handled?
faqs.a: The Privacy Policy explains how Sovely Dropshipping collects and uses personal data. This FAQ does not describe its details, so read that page for specifics such as what is collected, how it is used and how to raise a data request.

faqs.q: What if this FAQ and a policy page differ?
faqs.a: The policy page is the authority. This FAQ is a summary, and policies can be updated, so check the current policy page for any decision that affects money or an order.

faqs.q: What support will I get after I join?
faqs.a: Help with platform usage, product selection, order fulfilment and operational queries. Basic includes a dedicated support team; Shopify and Combo include a dedicated account manager; Amazon includes lifetime support and a dedicated account manager.

faqs.q: How do I report a damaged, defective, missing or wrong item?
faqs.a: Contact support within 48 hours of delivery with an unboxing video and supporting documents, as.

faqs.q: How do I raise a complaint or escalate an unresolved issue?
faqs.a: Start with your support contact or account manager. For formal escalation, use the process in the Grievance Redressal Policy (available on the Sovely Dropshipping portal after login). This FAQ does not list its steps or response times.
